properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03: a_held_designs_read_is_as_true_as_the_live_one.rs (#657) fails ONE of its six tests in some CI runs, a different one each time, at its hold() helper ('the --serve-shared server never took the store'), main's run on 72bf252 included. Cause measured: hold()'s first --call probe can open the store before the spawned daemon does, and the daemon then exits by design
properties.statement:
Met while watching CI for fix program item 7a. OBSERVED, three GitHub Actions runs, job 'workspace + real-binary instruments':
- main 72bf252 (#658 merged after #657), run 37110378324: a_copy_that_fails_part_way_leaves_nothing_behind FAILED, panicked at a_held_designs_read_is_as_true_as_the_live_one.rs:202 'the --serve-shared server never took the store'.
- PR #661 merge commit, run 37110035396: a_held_design_finds_by_search_and_topic_what_it_holds, same line and message.
- PR #661 merge commit, run 37112427296: a_held_read_answers_a_held_write_refuses_and_nothing_is_written_beside_the_store, same line and message.
NOT AFFECTED: #657's own CI run passed; main 230008c (#657 alone) and main 293f957 passed; a rerun of the failed job on this PR passed; on this 4-core box the file passed 6/6 inside a full workspace run with two test threads, and failed 1 of 6 when run alone with four.

CAUSE, MEASURED with a replica of hold() (hold_repro2.sh beside the cost script; the same seed, the daemon's stderr kept): 20 runs, five at a time; 2 never held, and in both the daemon had exited with 'not becoming the shared server … another process already has the design graph … open … the store lock picks one winner and the rest exit here'. The other process is hold()'s own first probe: it is spawned the instant the daemon is, and a door READ of a store nobody holds yet opens the real store, so when it wins the lock the daemon exits by design and no later probe can ever see a holder. The 18 that held did so on the first probe. So it is a race in the test helper, not in the code it tests; waiting for the daemon's rendezvous file (<graph>.server.json) before the first probe would remove it. The step-2 change does not touch serving or reads.
